about: Claude Code (checked against v2.1.278 at 40 rows and v2.1.289 at 45x18). Its composer is a box between two full-width rules with the footer under it; its dialogs replace box and footer, and end with an 'Esc to cancel' hint under the last rule. Title and spinner patterns follow herdr's claude manifest (src/detect/manifests/claude.toml, 2026.09.11.1).

rules.about: The whole dialog, not a five-row tail: at phone height its options and their wrapped rows fill more than five.
The folder-trust dialog and other choosers without digits.
Below the dialogs on purpose: a question on screen is worth a push even if the title still spins. Braille covers <= 2.1.227, half circles 2.1.228+; '✳' is the idle title and matches nothing here.
The spinner row of a running turn ('✻ Thinking… (12s · esc to interrupt)'). The finished-turn summary ('✻ Worked for 14s · done') has no ellipsis and does not match.
Every row of the box, so a draft that wraps (the cursor on its second row) is still a draft. Dim text is Claude's own placeholder.
Startup, /clear and /new: the banner is up and Claude has not answered anything yet, so there is nothing that finished.

line_regex: (?i)do you want|would you like|proceed\?|continue\?|are you sure
